contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [...] GER DAC VI[...] ; R/ [...] SPQR OP[TIMO] [...]

A copper alloy Roman coin as or dupondius of Trajan (98-117 AD). Probably mint of Rome. Reece Period 5. Remains of the obverse legend reads: [...] GER DAC VI[...]. The reverse seems to depict a horse and rider galloping right, trampling an enemy soldier; reverse legend reads: [...] SPQR OP[TIMO] [...].
